title: Pharmaceutical Distribution
thesis: Snowflake forecasts pharmaceutical demand by SKU and region, automates replenishment via event-driven Tasks, and alerts distribution teams on stockout risk — replacing reactive ordering with predictive supply chain management

talking_points: Network service level at 96.8% (target: 99.2%) — ฿340M in lost sales from stockouts.
Forty-seven critical SKUs at stockout risk within 7 days across the network.
Working capital in inventory: ฿4.8B — opportunity to reduce by ฿720M with better forecasting.
tabs.call_out: 96.8% service level — 47 critical SKUs at risk within 7 days

transition.line: Let's see what demand forecasting predicts.

talking_points: ML.FORECAST generates daily predictions for 45,000 SKU-region combinations.
Insulin demand in Northeast region: predicted 18% increase (diabetes prevalence rising).
Tender pipeline: 3 hospital tenders closing next month will drive ฿85M in demand for oncology drugs.
show: Show demand forecast dashboard by product category
Click insulin category for regional detail
tabs.call_out: 45,000 forecasts updated daily — tender pipeline integrated

transition.line: How does this translate to replenishment actions?

talking_points: Event-driven replenishment: Tasks + Streams trigger orders when inventory crosses threshold.
ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION detects unusual demand spikes (e.g., flu season surge in antivirals).
Auto-generated PO recommendations consider lead times, MOQ, and forecast confidence.
tabs.call_out: Event-driven replenishment — from demand signal to PO in 2 hours

transition.line: Now let the VP ask the system directly.

talking_points: Preecha asks: 'Which SKUs should we expedite orders for this week?'
Cortex Analyst: Returns priority list — 12 SKUs need emergency replenishment, 35 need acceleration.
Switch to advisor: 'What's the optimal safety stock for insulin across regions?' — generates analysis with cost tradeoffs.
show: Type: 'SKUs requiring expedited orders this week'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL supply chain analytics + inventory advisory

talking_points: Seven Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
Kinesis streams orders; EventBridge/Tasks trigger replenishment; ML.FORECAST drives predictions.
Thailand's pharma market: ฿200B. This manages 5,000 SKUs across 9 distribution centers.
tabs.call_out: Demand signal → forecast → replenishment — automated end-to-end

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Thai pharmaceutical distribution.
